## JSON to Code 
 - Turn a JSON selection into a ready to use model class 
 - Long press a JSON object or array to grab the whole block, or select the text yourself 
 - Nothing is generated until text is actually selected 
 - 20 output languages: Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, C#, C++, Go, Rust, Swift, Dart, Ruby, Scala, Groovy, Perl, Lua, R, Shell and SQL 
 - Nested objects and arrays are typed recursively, and the file is written to the project root then opened in the editor
